description:
Once upon a time, there was a prince famous far and wide for his beauty. His skin was white as snow, and he had blood-colour-... Blood-colored?! That is not just blood-coloured, that is actually blood though?! The temper of the beautiful prince grew nastier with each passing year, and what caused such a tyrannical beauty to explode most of all was... his new, young, and supercute stepmother! "You'd be somewhat pleasant to look at if you'd just fix your attitude", she said with a big smile, teasing the short-tempered prince who threatens to kill her every day. The prince refused to accept the new queen. Failing to overcome his burning anger and quick temper, was angry with his father - but the king had truly run out of patience with his idiot son, and finally chased him out of the house. Ah, the pitiful (?) Prince Snow White... He did not even realise that the queen's true identity is that of the evil witch, who was hired by the king to fix his son's horrid demeanor. 

Meanwhile, Prince Snow White has yet to figure out what dangers await him...

The fantasy(?) romance between a horrible prince and a suspicious queen - a reverse-gender Snow White fantasy romance smut by the author of [Good Girlfriend](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=51814743349)!
